comment: The `fjs add` registry. One entry per library fjs knows how to wire up.
deps/devDeps: written into package.json; an existing range is left alone.
shared: bare specifiers appended to package.json's fjs.shared, so a
--pages build keeps ONE module instance instead of a private
copy per page chunk. Needed for anything holding module state.
requires: native capabilities — `fjs native add <cap>` — not JS packages.
targets: omit for both; ['web'] or ['app'] to restrict.
plugin.source is an array of lines, joined with newlines when written.

source: // Module scope on purpose. On Flutter every page is its own Vue app, so
// this function runs once per page — creating the Pinia instance inside it
// would give each page a private set of stores that never share state.

packages.name: vue-i18n

source: // legacy: false picks the Composition API build, which does not need the
// runtime message compiler. Keep formatting to plain interpolation —
// QuickJS has no Intl, so $d / $n have nothing to call.

notes: QuickJS has no Intl: $d / $n and Intl-backed formats will not work on device.

packages.name: dayjs
notes: Use dayjs locales, not toLocaleString — QuickJS is built without Intl.
